title: Landing Page Loads
description: Verify the landing page loads with the correct headline and CTAs
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002
Verify the text FIRED is visible on the page
Verify the text HIRED is visible on the page
Verify a button or link with text I'm Looking for Work is visible
Verify a button or link with text I'm Hiring is visible

title: Candidate Login Success
description: Candidate can login and is redirected to dashboard or onboarding
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login
Click the button or link with text Job Seeker
Fill the email input with testcandidate@firedin.com
Fill the password input with Test1234!
Click the Sign In button
Verify the URL contains /candidate

title: Recruiter Login Success
description: Recruiter can login and sees the recruiter dashboard with sidebar
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login
Click the button or link with text Recruiter
Fill the email input with testrecruiter@firedin.com
Fill the password input with Test1234!
Click the Sign In button
Verify the URL contains /recruiter
Verify the text Jobs is visible on the page

title: Wrong Password Shows Error
description: Login with wrong password shows an error message
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login
Fill the email input with testcandidate@firedin.com
Fill the password input with WrongPass999!
Click the Sign In button
Verify an error message containing Invalid is visible

title: Register Page Has Role Tabs
description: Register page shows Job Seeker and Recruiter tabs
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/register
Verify the text Job Seeker is visible
Verify the text Recruiter is visible
Verify the text Create Account is visible

title: Forgot Password Page Loads
description: Forgot password page has email input and send button
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/forgot-password
Verify an email input field is visible
Verify the text Send Reset Code is visible
